source.title: [Continuity expansion] Games, physics character, creative cards and manufacturable coin housing
source.body: Parent #1908; existing game certification #961, images #1830, reusable templates #1662. For Infinity aluminum coin housing: locate original specs/art and build manufacturability pipeline (dimensions, CAD, tolerance, material, supplier RFQs, cost, prototype, QA, checkout) without claiming production or sales. Jobs: G01 30m inventory games; G02 30m game QA/import and rights; G03 20m physics/video sourcing; G04 30m creative card automation; G05 30m coin housing specification and supplier validation; G06 20m source-backed approvals/acceptance; G07 30m implement eligible changes/test/review/merge. Preserve full original work and no invented assets.
